summary: TOYO Co., Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 4,545,456 ordinary shares and accompanying purchase warrants to institutional investors at $11.00 per unit, with warrants exercisable at $13.20 for five years. The offering raised ~$50M gross; Roth Capital Partners and H.C. Wainwright acted as co-placement agents receiving $0.605 per unit fee. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. There are no deal terms beyond the offering price and warrant exercise price; no premium, merger, or restructuring elements are present. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5). No further risk-arb angle.
